test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vain
solution:
The correct answer is: **Modest**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Vain **means having or showing undue or excessive pride in one's appearance or achievements. (किसी की उपस्थिति या उपलब्धियों में अनुचित या अत्यधिक गर्व होना या दिखाना)

 
 
• Example -* Their flattery made him vain.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Modest **means having a limited and not overly high opinion of oneself and one's abilities. (अपने और अपनी क्षमताओं के बारे में एक सीमित और अत्यधिक उच्च राय नहीं होना)
 
 
• Example -* He was a very modest man, refusing to take any credit for the enterprise.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Vain**' and '**Modest**' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Loyal **means giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance to a person or institution. (किसी व्यक्ति या संस्था को दृढ़ और निरंतर समर्थन या निष्ठा देना या दिखाना)
 
• **Unfair **means not morally right, or not treating people in an equal way. (नैतिक रूप से सही नहीं, या लोगों के साथ समान व्यवहार नहीं करना)
 
• **Energetic **means showing or involving great activity or vitality. (महान गतिविधि या जीवन शक्ति दिखाना या शामिल करना)
